cluster_type: HBaseTestingUtility MiniHBaseCluster with two region servers
source_audit_note: The original test directly calls relocateRegion on an enabled table. MetaTableAccessor.getTableState performs a hbase:meta Get before the disabled-table guard completes; the HBASE-01 scan response door is after this guard.
coverage_type: JaCoCo production method/branch/line counts for ConnectionImplementation, MetaTableAccessor and RpcRetryingCallerImpl

pilot_trial.note: Jacoco agent was registered after the target probe, so transformed class coverage did not match the production jar; repeated as r01.

stop_reason: Near trial 64, six strict faults exhausted the original test's six RPC attempts and added one production retry branch, so the authorized 128 ceiling was opened. The additional distinct five-fault order r066 added no production coverage or new I/O family. The observed meta table-state Get door has been exercised with 1–6 faults and all four legal exception families; seven or eight requests cannot match under the original retry limit. Further queued orders reuse the same door and retry paths, so the effective candidate queue was exhausted before the 128 ceiling.

instrumentation_provenance.counted_runtime: Native JUnit Platform launcher, case-local ByteBuddy agent, JaCoCo
instrumentation_provenance.exploratory_runner_note: One early uncounted healthy2 setup run used GraphChecker JUnitMethodRunner; no counted trial used it.
